  "overall_experience": "This Senior Overseer & Operations Manager likely found Zoho CRM to be a highly capable tool for managing their operations within the entertainment industry. The platform offered strong functionality and customization options, providing excellent value for their self-employed business. While there was an initial learning curve to master its extensive features, the overall benefits outweighed these challenges, leading to a generally positive experience over their 1-2 years of use."
